_comment: Cards for tests/unit/counters/test_enters_with_counters_per_death.py. `t_gorma` is Gorma, the Gullet's third line alone: nontoken creatures you control enter with an additional +1/+1 counter for each creature that died under your control this turn. `t_died_anthem` is the same tally as an anthem's magnitude, the general static value. `t_bear` (testing.cards.json, a vanilla 2/2) and `soldier_1_1_w` are what arrive and what dies.

cards.name: Test Gullet Gorma
cards.oracle_text: Nontoken creatures you control enter with an additional +1/+1 counter on them for each creature that died under your control this turn.

abilities.text: Nontoken creatures you control enter with an additional +1/+1 counter on them for each creature that died under your control this turn.

cards.name: Test Died Anthem
cards.oracle_text: Creatures you control get +X/+0, where X is the number of creatures that died under your control this turn.

abilities.text: Creatures you control get +X/+0, where X is the number of creatures that died under your control this turn.
